note: 24 Nov 2026. Mixed-bit recipes for the Flash-Next REAP cuts (Bobert 80%, Riker 70%, Bill 60%), stock llama.cpp types only, so every file loads on any llama.cpp (CUDA, Vulkan, CPU, the Go). Idea credited to llamAmpere (MIT, v0.7.4: bulk at one type, structural tensors higher; its Flash-Next MTP head keeps hyper-connection and indexer tensors at high precision) and Unsloth's dynamic quants. pod/quant_recipe.py predicts sizes and writes the llama-quantize options; rules are tried in order, first match wins, as in llama-quantize. 'layers' picks layers from layer_rank (most sensitive first): top:N, or bottom:N for the least sensitive.
layer_rank_note: Until pod/layer_rank.py has read a cut's imatrix (tensor statistics), the rank is a placeholder: llama.cpp's own more-bits pattern (first and last eighth of the layers first, then every third layer). File sizes don't depend on which layers are picked, only how many, so the dry-run sizes hold either way.

rules.why: 160 wide: no type under 4.5 bits fits (~29 GB, read from RAM/SSD, not the card)
hyper-connection mixers steer every layer; llama.cpp keeps hc_ unquantized for glm5-next and xing4_0 but not qwen4exp, so IQ2_XXS put hc_*_down/inject at 2 bits. ~0.35 GB at q8_0
gated delta net gates (llamAmpere's ATX recipe raises these); tiny
the shared expert runs for every token; ~0.25 GB at q8_0
the word-table mixer of layer 1; tiny

recipes.name: IQ2_XXS
recipes.why: as made on the pods 23-24 Nov (down experts q2_0, output_hc_* q8_0 from imatrix_gaps, word table q4_0)

recipes.name: Q3_K_M
recipes.why: as made on the pods (no imatrix_gaps step for K quants)

recipes.name: MX2_S
recipes.why: IQ2_XXS experts, everything that steers the model raised: does guarding the small tensors alone fix Bill's failed IQ2_XXS?

recipes.name: MX2_M
recipes.why: MX2_S, plus the 16 most sensitive layers' gate/up experts at iq2_s and the 8 most sensitive layers' down experts at q4_0: about IQ2_M's size, bits where they matter

recipes.name: MX3_S
recipes.why: between IQ2_M and Q3_K_M: gate/up iq3_xxs in the 16 most sensitive layers and iq2_s elsewhere, down q4_0 in 16 layers, attention q6_k

recipes.name: MX1_S
recipes.why: Bobert only (his IQ2_XXS passed): MX2_S with the 16 least sensitive layers' gate/up experts at iq1_m, to bring the most-kept cut down toward Riker's IQ2_XXS size. Not for Bill: his IQ2_XXS already failed
